providerDefault: model dependent, exposed as `Model.temperature` from `getModel`. Google says 1.0 for Gemini 3 models.
summary: Controls randomness. Google strongly recommends leaving it at the default 1.0 for all Gemini 3 models, image models included.
combines: Supported on: all Gemini models, Gemini Developer API
Lowering temperature below 1.0 on Gemini 3 can cause looping or degraded performance. This is the explicit migration advice from the Gemini 3 guide.
note: Fixed at the provider-recommended value; not exposed.
